name: emw-aretomo3-pipeline
help:
Wrapper to run aretomo3 automated reconstruction. 

*REFERENCES*:
[[https://github.com/czimaginginstitute/AreTomo3/][AreTomo3]]

params.name: input_tiltseries
params.label: Input tilt series:
params.help: STAR file with input tilt-series

params.name: fm_int
params.label: Frames per MC interval
params.help: (--FmInt) E.g. 12 means groups of 12 EER frames are summed before alignment. Required for EER data — do not use for TIFF.

params.name: eer_sampling
params.label: EER upsampling factor
params.help: (--EerSampling) Directly determines the maximum achievable resolution.

params.name: mc_bin
params.label: Fourier-space binning during MC
params.help: (--McBin) Use 2 for EER data with EerSampling=2 to reduce memory. Higher values reduce precision.

params.name: mc_patch
params.label: Patches (XxY):
params.help: (--McPatch) More patches capture more local motion. 5x5 works well for cryo-ET; 1x1 = full-frame alignment only.

params.name: mc_group
params.label: Frame grouping (global x patch):
params.help: (--Group) First number = global alignment grouping, second = patch alignment grouping, e.g. '1x3'. Empty = no grouping.

params.name: align_z
params.label: Volume height for alignment
params.help: (--AlignZ) Internal volume height used during tilt series alignment. Should be ~1.5–2× expected sample thickness in voxels at the alignment binning. Does not affect final tomogram Z.

params.name: ts_import.override_axis
params.label: angle (deg)
params.help: (--TiltAxis, 1st value) Known tilt axis angle in degrees. Leave empty to let AreTomo3 search the full range automatically.

params.name: tilt_axis_refine
params.label: refinement
params.help: (--TiltAxis, 2nd value) Controls refinement range around the provided angle. Only relevant when an angle is provided. 0 = refine ±10°, any positive value = refine ±3°, any negative value = use angle as-is with no refinement.

params.name: at_patch
params.label: Local alignment patches (XxY):
params.help: (--AtPatch) e.g. '4x4'. Improves alignment for samples with local thickness variation. Empty = global alignment only.

params.name: dark_tolerance
params.label: Dark image tolerance
params.help: (--DarkTol) Threshold (0–1) for discarding dark/empty tilt images. Higher = more aggressive. Set to 0 to disable (recommended when debugging).

params.name: ctf_amp_contrast
params.label: Amplitude contrast
params.help: (--AmpContrast) Typically 0.07–0.10 for cryo-ET. Affects CTF fit quality.

params.name: correct_ctf
params.label: Enable local CTF correction
params.help: (--CorrCTF) Apply local CTF correction on the raw tilt series before reconstruction. Leave on by default; disable only if data is pre-corrected.

params.name: vol_z
params.label: Volume Z height
params.help: (--VolZ) Must be > 0 to produce a tomogram. 0 = aligned tilt series only (no reconstruction). -1 = auto-estimate thickness.

params.name: extra_z
params.label: Extra volume Z padding
params.help: (--ExtZ) Extra space added to the estimated sample thickness for final reconstruction. Only relevant when Volume Z height = -1.

params.name: at_bin
params.label: primary
params.help: (--AtBin, 1st value) Primary tomogram binning relative to motion-corrected tilt series.

params.name: at_bin2
params.label: secondary (optional)
params.help: (--AtBin, 2nd value) Optional second resolution tomogram. Leave empty to disable.

params.name: wbp
params.label: Use weighted back-projection (WBP)
params.help: (--Wbp) Recommended over SART for most cryo-ET. When disabled, SART is used instead (see below).

params.name: sart_iter
params.label: iterations
params.help: (--Sart, 1st value) Number of SART iterations.

params.name: sart_proj
params.label: projections/update
params.help: (--Sart, 2nd value) Number of projections per update.

params.name: tilt_cor
params.label: Tilt angle offset correction

choices.-1: Skip — do not measure or apply
choices.0: Measure only — used for alignment, not applied to reconstruction
choices.1: Measure and apply — also corrects final reconstruction

params.help: (--TiltCor) Controls whether the tilt angle offset is measured, and whether that correction is carried through to the reconstructed volume. It is not recommended to enable this option (-TiltCor 1) when subtomogram average is part of your workflow since this option rotates the volume around its tilt axis. The z coordinates of particles picked from the rotated tomogram would be different from the coordinates in the sample.

params.name: recon_range_min
params.label: min
params.help: (--ReconRange, 1st value) Minimum tilt angle (deg) included in reconstruction.

params.name: recon_range_max
params.label: max
params.help: (--ReconRange, 2nd value) Maximum tilt angle (deg) included in reconstruction.

params.name: flip_vol
params.label: Save volume as XYZ
params.help: (--FlipVol) Save the tomogram in XYZ order instead of default XZY. Enable for compatibility with IMOD, Relion, and WARP.

params.name: out_imod
params.label: IMOD output format

choices.3: Aligned tilt series as input for Relion4/WARP

params.help: (--OutImod) Generates IMOD-compatible files needed for downstream subtomogram averaging, saved in a subfolder named after the output MRC file.

params.name: split_sum
params.label: Generate odd/even sums
params.help: (--SplitSum) When enabled, 3 tilt series and 3 tomograms are generated. Odd/even outputs are appended _ODD and _EVN.

params.name: extra_a3_args
params.label: AreTomo3 extra arguments
params.help: Extra arguments to pass to AreTomo3

params.name: gpus
params.label: GPUs
params.help: If a single number (N), it represents the total number of GPUs (0..N-1). If multiple values, these are specific GPU IDs.

params.name: cpus
params.label: CPUs
params.help: If empty, the program will use the number of GPUs * 10 CPUs.

params.name: register_output_only
params.label: Register output only
params.help: If enabled, the job will only register the output files, but not run the program.

params.label: Launchers
params.help: Launchers to use for the different programs

params.name: launcher_aretomo3
params.label: AreTomo3
params.help: Launcher to use for AreTomo3
